parsed.why: No criminalisation, no facility/custody exclusion, neutral border. But active state hostility (2024 education ban, constitutional biological-sex ruling), failing hate-crime enforcement and documented group violence keep it mid-Elevated.

Criminalised conduct plus documented state-directed targeting: 2018 witch hunts, forced anal examinations, custody torture, official punishment committees, website blocking, 2024 mutilation of a trans activist. No recourse.

Protective machinery that operatively reaches trans people: gender-identity prison protocol, identity-congruent school facilities, migration non-discrimination, hate-crime aggravator; only isolated violence and a regression trend.

State-imposed universal exposures dominate: birth-sex single-sex-space code, strip-searches, custody and hospital-ward placement by birth sex, a ward-exclusion death. Functioning courts enforce the hostile rule, not remedy it.

Strong constitutional and statutory protections, gender-identity law, no facility or custody exclusions; but enforcement documented as weak and a 2024 survey records widespread LGBTI exclusion. Mid-Elevated.
